text: The Nominating Panel – Committee of Adjustment will select candidates to be interviewed for appointment by City Council to the Committee of Adjustment. The Nominating Panel will conduct interviews at its next meeting and recommend one candidate to City Council for appointment.

The Nominating Panel - Committee of Adjustment: 1. Selected the following candidates for interview for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment: Candidate COA2-373 Candidate COA2-463 Candidate COA2-511 Candidate COA2-520 Candidate COA2-524 Candidate COA2-529 Candidate COA2-534 Candidate COA2-550 Candidate COA2-551 Candidate COA2-557 2. Directed that Confidential Attachments 1 and 2 to the report (May 14, 2025) from the City Clerk remain confidential in their entirety as they relate to personal matters about identifiable individuals being considered for appointment to the Committee of Adjustment.
